system.monsterType: Killer Whale: Normal Animal (Common); Great Whale: Giant Animal (Very Rare); Nar
system.description: They live by hunting other sea creatures. Creatures of halfling size or smaller will be swallowed whole if the killer whale scores a 20 on its hit roll. Those swallowed take 1d6 points of damage per round and will drown in 10 rounds unless freed.
system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;Killer Whale: </strong> </strong> These are 25' long and are found mainly in cold waters. Those swallowed take 1d6 points of damage per round and will drown in 10 rounds unless freed.&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
